sources.title: Opening hours
sources.content: Juniper Table is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. On Saturday and Sunday it is open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The kitchen closes 30 minutes before the restaurant.

sources.title: Menu
sources.content: Juniper Table serves brunch until 2:00 PM. The garden bowl contains quinoa, roasted vegetables, and tahini dressing. The mushroom melt is made with sourdough, mushrooms, and Swiss cheese. The children's menu includes a grilled cheese with fruit.

sources.title: Dietary information
sources.content: The garden bowl can be made vegan by omitting the tahini dressing. The kitchen uses separate utensils for gluten-free orders but is not an allergen-free facility. The mushroom melt contains dairy and gluten. Guests should tell their server about allergies.

sources.title: Reservations
sources.content: Reservations are accepted for parties of six or more by phone. Smaller parties are seated in order of arrival. A reservation is held for 15 minutes after its scheduled time.

sources.title: Policies
sources.content: Guests may bring a celebration cake with advance notice; a $12 cake service fee applies. The patio is dog-friendly. Takeout orders are available for pickup, but delivery is not offered.
